spans.s: Draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ saṁvādaḥ: : Name of the 38th parvan in the list of a hundred sub-parvans of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha (saṁvādaś ca tataḥ parva draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ)

, 33, 70.

The incident is mentioned while listing the contents of the Āraṇyakaparvan (saṁvādaś caiva satyayā) 1. 2. 125; the parvan is related to the adhyāyas 3. 222224.

Draupadīsvayaṁvara : m.: This name does not occur in the text. [See Pāñcālyāḥ svayaṁvaram ]

Related to the adhyāyas 1. 174-189.

Draupadīharaṇa : nt.: Name of the 42nd parvan in the list of a hundred sub-parvans of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha

, 33, 70.

Draupadī's abduction was attempted by the Sindhu king (Jayadratha)

; the incident is mentioned while listing the contents of the Āraṇyakaparvan 1. 2. 123-124; the parvan is related to the incidents of the adhyāyas 3. 248-256.
